basis: Defined by cerebral and cerebellar malformations, severe developmental impairment and intractable epilepsy.
Congenital absence of eyelid tissue; eyelids belong to the ocular axis.

Infection-related scarring narrows the urethra, which belongs to the renal axis.
Childhood neoplasm arising in the infratentorial brain.
A primary headache disorder classified as a neurological pain disorder.
Neurodegenerative ataxia; cardiomyopathy ~50-70% and skeletal deformities >30% in the Friedreich phenotype, though FRDA2-specific frequencies are uncertain.
Mucin accumulation damages hair follicles and causes alopecia; associated lymphomas are separate diseases.
Mitochondrial metabolic myopathy; neurologic deterioration and cardiomyopathy each frequent (30-79%). Frequent visual impairment omitted by the four-axis cap.
Defined by congenital finger, toe and thoracic skeletal abnormalities.
Autoimmune microvascular disease without skin fibrosis; esophageal dysfunction ~70-90% and interstitial lung disease ~40-60% support visceral involvement.
Skin, dental and intellectual abnormalities define disease; infantilism with delayed puberty in 80-99% supports endocrine involvement. Kidney stones are separately diagnosed.
Familial actinic keratosis is a keratinizing skin disorder.
Brain, oral and digital malformations define disease; retinal coloboma 30-79%. Frequent cardiac, epiglottic and urethral anomalies omitted by the four-axis cap.
Inherited congenital ocular motor dysfunction with horizontal jerk nystagmus in 3/3; no additional neurologic disease documented.
Inherited skeletal myopathy caused by defective alpha-dystroglycan glycosylation; brain and eye abnormalities characterize only some subtypes.
Carcinoma arising in the floor of the mouth; oral tissues and salivary glands belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Asymmetric motor neuropathy denotes the immune-mediated multifocal motor neuropathy phenotype, affecting peripheral motor nerves.
Neurodevelopmental disorder; retinal dystrophy 2/2, enamel hypoplasia 1/1 and pulmonic stenosis 1/2 support involvement, with uncertainty from very small reported subsets.
Middle-ear inflammation caused by pathological type I hypersensitivity.
Antibody immunodeficiency caused by absent, reduced or dysfunctional B cells; infections and their organ complications are separate diseases.
Inherited reticulate skin pigmentation disorder with follicular abnormalities; no common extracutaneous functional damage established.
Nebulin-related nemaline myopathies primarily damage skeletal muscle; respiratory weakness reflects muscle dysfunction rather than direct lung disease.
Defined by intellectual disability and microcephaly, generalized bone hypoplasia and reduced muscle mass, and cleft palate reported in all patients.
Papillary carcinoma arising in the thyroid endocrine gland, measuring 10 mm or less.
